items.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023
items.q: It reminds me of a dear friend of mine, Joe Wilder who had that big, beautiful, mellow tone.

ctx.x: It’s a little warmer sound, you know, and it’s a little air within the sound, which is made a little more human.
Yes. It reminds me of a dear friend of mine, Joe Wilder who had that big, beautiful, mellow tone.

Also for example, nowadays a lot of trumpet players don’t even have a clue who was Bunny Berigan or Harry James. I love Harry James’ sound. I love Harry James’ sound. And I do a good imitation of him. Because I’ve been like a kind of a — how would I say — like a chameleon. I’ve been a kind of chameleon all my life because I pay attention and I want to learn the nuances and specific detail of all the great players that I admire and respect. And this is my Harry James.
